notes.title: About Ultimate PRO, Xbox and Nintendo Switch
notes.notes:
[h2]What's up, drivers!
[/h2][h3]Ultimate PRO[/h3][p]Due to technical compatibility issues with the legacy Xbox version, we are temporarily removing Ultimate PRO. It will be refined based on your feedback and reinstated with the release of the upcoming Xbox update.[/p][p][/p][h3]Xbox and Nintendo Switch[/h3][p]Updates for Xbox have not been released for over four months. At present, we are unable to deliver updates for this platform due to circumstances beyond the control of the development team. We are making every effort to resume content releases and will inform you as soon as it becomes possible.[/p][p][/p][p]For Nintendo console users, there is positive news — an update is expected in the near future.[/p][p][/p][p]We encourage you to follow our social media channels and Discord server to stay informed about the latest developments.[/p]

notes.title: Announcement of update 2.26.2
notes.notes: [h1]What's up, drivers!  [/h1][h3][b]We want to share a little bit of news with you about the upcoming update. What are we preparing for you?[/b][/h3][hr][/hr][h2][b]New modification - Ultimate PRO[/b][/h2][p]This is an improved version of Ultimate with a reworked balance and the additional ability to change the car's mass. The new modification will provide comfortable handling for beginners and preserve the potential of competitive driving for experienced players.[/p][h2][b]New XDS configs[/b][/h2][p]7 new XDS configs will be added to the single-player tandem drift game.[/p][h2][b]New filters and settings for multiplayer rooms[/b][/h2][p]In the new update, we will expand the settings for multiplayer rooms so you can create a fair and more predictable conditions for all its players.[/p][p]Now when you create a room, you will have access to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Room Type[/b] - “Drift”, “Time Attack”, or for all. This will help you immediately understand what style of driving you prefer[/p][/*][*][p][b]Power density restriction[/b] - now all participants will be on equal footing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drivetrain type and TCS (Traction Control System)[/b] - another step towards more balanced competition races.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Advanced telemetry for spectator mode[/b][/h2][p]In multiplayer, car parameters and controller type will be displayed when the player is observed.[/p][h2][b]Enhanced Rich Presence[/b][/h2][p]In the “Friends” tab in Steam, you can see more information about your friends' current activity in the game.[/p][h3][b]Stay tuned for more information on the upcoming update![/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/635260/CarX_Drift_Racing_Online/"][/dynamiclink]Enjoy! ❤️[/p][p][b]CarX Drift Racing Online[/b] Team [/p]

notes.title: About update 2.26.0: New filters and settings for multiplayer rooms
notes.notes: [h1]What's up, drivers!  [/h1][h3][b]We want to share a little bit of news with you about the upcoming update! [/b][/h3][hr][/hr][h2][b]New filters and settings[/b][/h2][p]In the new update, we will expand the settings for multiplayer rooms so you can create a fair and more predictable conditions for all its players.[/p][p]Now when you create a room, you will have access to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Room Type[/b] - “Drift”, “Time Attack”, or for all. This will help you immediately understand what style of driving you prefer[/p][/*][*][p][b]Power density restriction[/b] - now all participants will be on equal footing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drivetrain type and TCS (Traction Control System)[/b] - another step towards more balanced competition races.[/p][/*][/list][p]Also the settings “[b]Voting[/b]”, “[b]Clipping Points[/b]”, ‘[b]Drift[/b]’ and “[b]Time Attack[/b]” are now always active by default when creating a room.[/p][h3][b]Stay tuned for more information on the upcoming update![/b][/h3][hr][/hr][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/635260/CarX_Drift_Racing_Online/"][/dynamiclink]Enjoy! ❤️[/p][p][b]CarX Drift Racing Online[/b] Team [/p]

notes.title: PTR Update: 2.25.2 v.1
2.25.1 Update is here!
notes.notes:
What’s up, drivers! 
We’re excited to announce that the 2.25.0 update is now available for CarX Drift Racing Online players on Steam.

What’s new:

[b]You can now save both visual and technical settings of a car as a preset.[/b] Presets act as containers that store specific versions of a car.
By default, each car has one preset available. Additional presets can be unlocked by completing tasks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/4d94003fa073498240ab094b62dfb9366a16a42f.png[/img]

Switch between presets not only in the garage but also during a race. You can also rename and copy presets as needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/54644e91933c7e82340a5823fa553b9db14f59b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/0539ed386bb37ead20d721ce7de8fc1dea790be5.png[/img]

[b]You can now replace and customize the engine in the Racing setup. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/38eaef8edecaca60c1a60b44e17eca06af78e6a6.png[/img]

Engine unlocks work the same way as in the Ultimate setup.

[b]The Racing setup now supports switching the drivetrain[/b], with three available options:
RWD (Rear-Wheel Drive) – Power is delivered to the rear wheels, ideal for drifting.
AWD (All-Wheel Drive) – Power is distributed across all wheels depending on grip; good for circuit racing.
4WD (Four-Wheel Drive) – Power is sent equally to all wheels; perfect for off-road or extreme conditions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/99f5131351c5e68a14b94872ba4a72afbe92a0e1.png[/img]

[b]TCS Configuration.[/b] 
Traction Control System (TCS) is now available in the Racing setup. When enabled, TCS adjusts engine power to reduce wheel slip during acceleration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/7caf27ee80df3b39ad5ab72caa6128b0a1601c07.png[/img]

[b]Power-to-Weight Indicator.[/b] 
A new indicator has been added to the “Modifications,” “Dyno Stand,” and “Modification Workshop” sections. It shows the car's specific power (power per kilogram). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/281cdb259bd23655d7c9a718bde8811ff67978da.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/d32725fc755335f83524b526116aef0fba60bdfb.png[/img]

[b]Global Map Access from Pause Menu.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/71ef681aa29cc47d099feae4fb0e362a502ea7e2.png[/img]

You can now access the global map from the pause menu. It shows real-time locations of all players along with their current status (paused, on the dyno stand, applying a livery, etc.) and teleportation points.

[b]The photo mode has been significantly improved with many new settings.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/1aa425a416031d68b306d294b81d649d6f674453.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/5b0246bb7ed5b51dc8bf86bc14b6c7a5e6d33f8b.png[/img]

[b]New cars: Cobra S and Ridge GT [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/059ed886383a03dc86cde4bffacd14e15d6c5b15.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/8be4f1da57883b2a2f794da0701bd57a023c163d.jpg[/img]

[b]New stickers added[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/86b24480e7e7ec24e4f54f5274fde3fec947b32c.png[/img]

[b]Added the option to set a slot without a livery.
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/f9982bded03d3746cf8ba057be03191aaccaf6b9.png[/img]

[b]Drone Camera Height Limit Removed.[/b]
On some custom maps with large elevation differences, the drone camera could hit invisible height limits. This restriction has now been removed.

[b]New DLCs are available now: 
Car Presets Unlock
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559570/CarX_Drift_Racing_Online__Car_Presets_Unlock/

Wild Union 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559630/CarX_Drift_Racing_Online__Wild_Union/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/5dd3717dda815af1074d2cb6b6a4a96ad04de9f0.png[/img]

Meowtor Madness[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3559650/CarX_Drift_Racing_Online__Meowtor_Madness/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/cff074a7d41ac14f653ca0f3f96e77180f64ab98.png[/img]

Have fun!

notes.title: Development update.
notes.notes:
What's up drivers! 

Today we want to share some news about our work on the project and tell you what new features to expect in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/19c67904239ebde726d395b3b8f4fabbc91b8e50.jpg[/img]

✅ Collision Fix in Multiplayer.
In the current version of the game, the collision disable timer does not work quite correctly: the player collision status was not being updated, so some players could push other players without any response.
This bug fix is already 100% complete and will be available in the next game update.

✅ Custom Maps for Consoles.
We are working on this feature, and the overall progress on this task can be estimated at 70-80%. 
Unfortunately, we had to spend a lot of time studying all the necessary legal and technical requirements of the platforms and developing a concept that fully meets them.
We will be able to provide more information a bit later, but for now, we can state that this feature will work on consoles just like on PC. 
Modded maps will be equally available on Xbox and Sony PlayStation, but there will be a delay before publication due to preliminary moderation of the maps.
We plan to complete development during this summer, but note that this is a preliminary estimate - we have a complex testing process ahead, which may take time.

✅ Car Swap during the race.
The long-awaited feature of swapping cars without having to leave the race will be available for single-player mode and multiplayer. 
We are working to make the car swap seamless for the server, but already, players don't need to worry that someone else will take their place in the room during the change.
Development of this mechanic is 95% complete and is already being tested, and it will come to the game with the next update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/12ed5026ec1532084c022f180ca00b1740159eea.png[/img]

✅ Wheel Rotation in the Dyno Stand.
To improve working with the dyno stand experience, we will add the ability to rotate the wheels - previously this happened only automatically. 
Now players will have the option to do this manually.
Development of this mechanic is 95% complete, and it will come to the game with the next update.

✅ New Stickers.
Work on 19 new stickers is 100% complete, and they will be added to the game with the next update, and will also be available on consoles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/9da13364b9780fd93c82b7d6f0183ccc6ad9a071.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/847aadad624f637583b57d562cdf5e2f9c5f0ebe.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/d8362c7e4c90966469c4c0e1bfff3ad21c8bb11d.jpg[/img]

✅ Car Shaking in Drone Camera Mode.
Thanks to feedback from our players, we were able to detect and solve this issue, and this fix will be included in the next update.
The development is now 100% complete and is already being tested.

✅ New Content.
We are also working on adding new content to the game: with the next update,  players can expect at least one new car and a new body kit.
Work on the new content is approximately 50% complete.

❗Drivers, we will continue to keep you informed about our work on the game and share the status of tasks and updates, so stay tuned for news not to miss a thing!
Thank you for playing with us. ❤

notes.title: About 2.21.1 update
notes.notes:
What’s up drivers. 

For 10 years, since the release of the very first version of our mobile CarX Drift Racing game, we’ve been paying close attention to the reaction of our audience and up to this day we believe that the trust of our players is the most important asset of CarX Technologies. 

Every step of development and our work process is connected with adding new content. We are gathering feedback from our players constantly to get insights on exactly what new content we should add to our games, and each time we get and idea of a specific content bundle that we work on to adapt and add to our games. 

In early April, this year, we’ve received a message from a content creator, claiming that our content recently added to CarX Drift Racing Online was, in fact, based on his work. 

We’ve examined this claim carefully and, yes, it’s possible to say that we took inspiration from this creator’s work, however we did not notify him or ask for his permission to use his work as reference. 
We’d like to apologize to the concept author, Cyro Miguel and, we are currently working together to resolve this issue by entering a license agreement with the author. 

We’d like to thank our players for the attention to such details and all the feedback. No doubt, we will improve our internal processes and workflow to prevent this kind of situation from happening again and to provide updates with quality content. 
Inevitably, all controversial, dividing or inappropriate content will be removed from our games forever or until the related issues are resolved, if possible. 

We highly appreciate feedback from our community and content makers on our games. 
Thanks for making better games with us!

CarX Drift Racing Online team is happy to announce, that PTR version of the 2.19.0 is already here and we’ve prepared something really special this time.

You’ve been waiting for this for a really long time and finally this day has come: now you can add your custom maps to the game with Steam Workshop! 

In the main menu, you can find new WORKSHOP tab where you’ll find LIVERY \ MODIFICATION and TRACK workshops. The last tab - is the place where you can find maps created by our amazing community. 

As for now, we’ve added small test map, just to test this feature properly, so feel free to try it out.

notes.title: 2.17.0 Update
notes.notes:
We are happy to present CarX Drift Racing Online 2.17.0 update! 
[b]And that’s what we’ve been working on for the last months. [/b]


[b]Modification workshop.[/b]

2.17.0 brings one of the most anticipated features for the players - setups sharing. Now, you can share your custom tunes with other players! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/781e16a43ef3caa94a8fb90113c8971c5d7ce114.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/726e04b380d072c01a2b200962aa68b355bdd91d.png[/img]

[b]Controller setup reworked.[/b]

We’ve significantly reworked controller settings and now CarX Drift Racing Online supports a great number of wheels, shifters and other controllers. Moza, Simcube, Simagic and many other controllers are now supported by the game. All you have to do - is to open game settings, go to controls - advanced settings and set up your controller scheme. 

After that you’ll have to choose type of your controllers in the game settings - controls - devices and choose device to make feedback active (FFB or controller’s vibration) and set up your buttons. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/e5f00fd65260edd0caf4bcc00857bb9e823192dc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/e8536fb3b451db0c0918b7a3ea0c8d2c2b7b51f1.png[/img]

[b]Binding’s tab reworked.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/b5b594415c79fa5b027962d65562836e0ff430d4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/3c31b86bd84f866fa0f6ab75431b9c884dc1744f.png[/img]

[b]Added option to use mouse wheel for gear change. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/75bc823cf4fc779e5799e77de197022feaf22e5a.png[/img]

[b]New XDS configurations.[/b]

New XDS configurations for Atron and L.A Block were added. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/a450a766b581d7fb03b71cbf9e604c1340147e0f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/960164963383371f8c796f85318839c21b813efe.png[/img]

[b]XDS deceleration zones. [/b]

We’ve added control over leader’s run speed on the following XDS configurations - ST.PETERSBURG 2, ATRON 3, SAN PALEZZO 1, L.A.BLOCK 2. In case, leader’s car will be too slow outside those zones (or even, too slow inside them) - leader will get relevant message. In case such slowdown will lead to crash - that’s going to be a leader’s fault.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/ab9e877b01cdafb9b2e36e16aab0359d87982770.png[/img]

[b]New cars. [/b]

Kizoku

[b]New DLC "Young Timers" added[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/72f76ded2c6d6e9fc7cf9d1a983fd26eac8d95c4.png[/img]

Loki 4GT

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/bf0bbb5eae1bfef5ed6ab899805c1aa3a4f2f1a7.png[/img]

Asura GXR

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/cd36d9a78f439155f992c287e6d1e20288794be6.png[/img]

Zismo Z4

[b]Location reworked: Castle Road Summer.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/7ed4c6c6e8093e02a8cd488f5ad9790a9633cfe0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/af35da4b231ce4c4f7ed4b5a549a9fdd66795598.png[/img]

[b]Crash sensitivity.[/b]

Sensitivity has been tweaked for XDS modes, increased for collision with location with objects and decreased for car's collisions.

[b]Stickers.[/b]

New tire stickers are coming with this update, with some new sticker-packs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/b3ef69406b492033e17267a97f41ba7d83b16b9a.png[/img]

[b]More. [/b]

Rims sorting by category updated;
Garage camera settings;
Bug Fixes;

Have fun!

notes.title: PTR 2.17.0 v.2
notes.notes:
What's up drivers!💥  

🔥 We are happy to inform you, that PTR 2.17.0 v.2 is already available!
 
What's new: 

✅  Added mouse control by acceleration (as in version 2.16.0 and earlier) and movement (available since version 2.17.0); 

✅  Reworked UI and logic in Settings-Control-Attached Devices section. Added selection of control scheme. 
When you select a control scheme, FFB is forcibly activated for the selected device.

✅ Swap icons updated;

✅ Preloader updated; 

✅ Starting car for new players will be given with Ultimate swap;

✅ Bug Fixes and Optimization; 

❗ We are aware of the issue with Moza R5 being not supported by the game, and we are already working on it, and we encourage you to check out this PTR  by yourself and let us know of the other devices with no support. 

❗ How can you play the PTR version of the update?
1. Go to the Steam library
2. Right Click on CarX Drift Racing Online
3. Select properties
4. Go to the BETA VERSIONS tab
5. Select latest PTR version
We are waiting for your feedback!

notes.title: Update 2.7.1
notes.notes:
[b]Patch notes:[/b]

[u][b]Physics[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Car physics was updated
[/list]

[u][b]Tracks[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed behavior of dynamic objects when interacting with a car. Now, cones and other objects will not cause a car to turn over when hitting them;
[*] Added new track - [b]ATRON[/b]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/071d70b5276836c9701f363005ec9225cbdee309.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/c9733ada678bba429624701d53600614ffff6e77.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/eb846f010a88d418f1df1d2cb6689a24e38eb3f5.jpg[/img]

[u][b]XDS[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with constant corrections
[*] Fixed problem with early completion of the race while safe mode is enabled
[/list]

[u][b]Tandem drift XDS[/b][/u]

In this update, we focused on reworking the tandem drift mode. The following changes were made to the rules of this mode:

[b]First run[/b]
[list]
[*] If one of the players is disqualified for a U-turn, off-the-track, etc., then the second run will still be held;
[*] If the follower is disqualified, the leader must end the run and receive his points, while the follower remains in the auto-brake mode;
[*] If the follower hit the leader - the victory will be automatically assigned to the leader, and the follower will be disqualified;
[*] If the follower was disqualified (did not collide with the leader), the leader will be able to get to the finish line and complete the race; 
[*]If the leader was disqualified, the follower automatically wins, and the race stops.
[/list]
[b]Second run[/b]
[list]
[*] If the leader has a technical victory (without points) and points for one more race, then he automatically wins the race;
[*] If both players have a technical victory (without points) and points for one more race, then the points will be compared. Technical wins do not count.
[/list]
[b]Draw[/b]
[list]
[*] If each player has 0 points for one of the races, as well as a technical victory (without points), there will be a draw in the race;
[*] Technical wins are not compared to ordinary points - a draw is immediately given;
[*] If a draw occurs during the race, then another race will be launched after the consent of both players. According to the results of this race, the winner will be determined.
[/list]
[b]Collision rules[/b]
[list]
[*] In a collision, the follower will always be to blame;
[*] If after a light contact the leader has deployed, straightened the wheels, or he has left the track, the follower will be disqualified.
[/list]

[u][b]Free camera[/b][/u]

Updated free camera mechanism. Added parameters for fine-tuning camera behavior. The camera has three modes: follow mode, autofocus mode and free camera mode.

The entrance to the free camera window is in the pause menu ([b]Hotkey G[/b]):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/547bdb244ecb65b9427a1716be138a9954ebfd45.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/5ed1afcb02ea8387daa781908b3d3fb378ca9e8b.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] In the following mode, the camera will move behind the selected target (player's own car or the car of another player), while allowing it to freely rotate the camera.
[*] In autofocus mode, the camera will strictly follow the selected car without the ability to rotate the camera.
[*] In free camera mode, the player fully controls the movement of the camera.
[/list]

[u][b]Replays[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem with broken wheel base in replays
[/list]

[u][b]Garage[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Updated garage lightning
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/484bacdab1c803910056db1e2f902ca307645dcf.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Steering wheels[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added support for Fanatec CSL Elite;
[*] Improved auto detection of Logitech and Thrustmaster steering wheels.
[/list]

[u][b]Steering Assist[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] The ability to turn off the steering assist on gamepads has been returned to the settings menu
[/list]

[u][b]Sounds[/b][/u]

Added the following parameters to the volume settings menu:
[list]
[*] Volume setting for player's car
[*] Volume setting for other's players cars
[*] Volume setting for ambient sounds

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/27fd7a20ce716350663953a920b91d7bef94910f.jpg[/img]

[*] Updated game sounds adjustments.
[*] Updated brake sounds.
[/list]

[u][b]Physics update[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]The physics of tires and suspension has been improved.
[/list]

[u][b]Other[/b][/u]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug when observing another player, when the pedals were displayed incorrectly in the indicator.
[*] Barriers on Red Ring have been fixed
[*] Physics stabilization
[*] Optimization.
[*] Anti-aliasing has been fixed
[*] Added an option to turn on/off pedals indicator

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/267bf5ab0499ba104ddc2103f6e0e5d54c55664b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/992ef11de143a5440fb60ecf7df1dd2626746679.jpg[/img]

[*]In the dyno, the part of UI with the current values of toe and camber was removed. Now the actual values are displayed in the parameter itself. The camber value will change dynamically when changing other suspension parameters, so consider this when setting up your car.
[/list]

[u][b]Bugs[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with saving tire pressure in the "Tandem Drift" mode in a single game;
[*] Fixed a bug with displaying rewards in the "Tandem Drift" mode in a single game;
[*] Fixed a bug with car recovery on tracks;
[*] Fixed a bug with the disappearing of the car body at a long distance from the free camera.
[/list]

[/list]
[b]Collision rules[/b]
[list]
[*] In a collision, the follower will always be to blame;
[*] If after a light contact the leader has deployed, straightened the wheels, or he has left the track, the follower will be disqualified.
[/list]

[u][b]Free camera[/b][/u]

Updated free camera mechanism. Added parameters for fine-tuning camera behavior. The camera has three modes: follow mode, autofocus mode and free camera mode.

The entrance to the free camera window is in the pause menu ([b]Hotkey G[/b]):
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/547bdb244ecb65b9427a1716be138a9954ebfd45.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/5ed1afcb02ea8387daa781908b3d3fb378ca9e8b.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] In the following mode, the camera will move behind the selected target (player's own car or the car of another player), while allowing it to freely rotate the camera.
[*] In autofocus mode, the camera will strictly follow the selected car without the ability to rotate the camera.
[*] In free camera mode, the player fully controls the movement of the camera.
[/list]

[u][b]Garage[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Updated garage lightning
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/484bacdab1c803910056db1e2f902ca307645dcf.jpg[/img]

[u][b]Steering wheels[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added support for Fanatec CSL Elite;
[*] Improved auto detection of Logitech and Thrustmaster steering wheels.
[/list]

[u][b]Other[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added an option to turn on/off pedals indicator

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/267bf5ab0499ba104ddc2103f6e0e5d54c55664b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29414514/992ef11de143a5440fb60ecf7df1dd2626746679.jpg[/img]

[*]In the dyno, the part of UI with the current values of toe and camber was removed. Now the actual values are displayed in the parameter itself. The camber value will change dynamically when changing other suspension parameters, so consider this when setting up your car.
[/list]

[u][b]Bugs[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with saving tire pressure in the "Tandem Drift" mode in a single game;
[*] Fixed a bug with displaying rewards in the "Tandem Drift" mode in a single game;
[*] Fixed a bug with car recovery on tracks;
[*] Fixed a bug with the disappearing of the car body at a long distance from the free camera.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 2.2.1
notes.notes:
Greetings!

What a wonderful day it is with CarX bringing another great news.

You guys know that we keep collecting all kinds of feedback coming from you because it helps us steer in the right direction doing our best to improve our game. Well, lately you’ve been bombarding us with requests to let you join online races on DLC tracks without having to buy extra content. We do want all our players to have access to more features and so this hotfix unlocks DLC tracks in online to join them in. 

However, keep in mind that some of the functionality will still be limited.



CarX Online Team

notes.title: Legacy version 1.9
notes.notes:
Eng:
Greetings!

At the request of many of our players, with the release of update 2.0, we added the ability to return the old graphics to those players who have performance problems with the new update.
To return to the version before graphics update, you need to open your Steam library, right-click on the name of the game and open the [b]“Properties”[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/0e041a51ff436ed0799195ad325028d26114c34b.jpg[/img]

After that, you need to go to the [b]“Beta”[/b] tab.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/c0b9b86d053f50b11f9d19236286fffb0ff66629.jpg[/img]

And select [b]“old_version_1.9”[/b].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/a8be71972b81290660c1b5ed94eabab5bcc4e8df.jpg[/img]

[b]Regards, CarX team[/b]

RU:
Приветствуем вас!

По просьбам многих наших игроков, с выходом обновления 2.0 мы добавили возможность вернуть старую графику для тех игроков, у которых возникли проблемы с производительностью на новой версии. 
Чтобы вновь вернуться в версию до изменения графики, вам необходимо открыть вашу библиотеку Steam, правой кнопкой кликнуть на название и игры и открыть [b]“Свойства”[/b]. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/1d61b34292ca8d49b5e464b5fa72b6244abff332.jpg[/img]

После чего, вам необходимо перейти во вкладку [b]“Бета-версии”[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/f798157e68a9a5aeef6e80453fed5977248a9b5d.jpg[/img]

И выбрать [b]“old_version_1.9”[/b]. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/8fb77f51f9373242f7b8640ef514ac95767cf6d5.jpg[/img]

[b]С уважением, команда CarX[/b]

notes.title: Questions and answers #2
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/a560ed541735cc3e87e11c4b7f9a55a612d0b557.jpg[/img]
[h1][b]Question:[/b][/h1]
Could offer us a rough estimate and how much time it will take to have mod support returned to the game and workshop so that all mods are visible to all players with the mods installed in multiplayer?
[h1][b]Answer:[/b][/h1]
At the moment we can not yet answer this question. We just want to say that we are working on supporting custom modifications.

[h1][b]Question:[/b][/h1]
I would like to ask if there is  any possibilty that support for custom maps will be added in the future? 
[h1][b]Answer:[/b][/h1]
Yes, but not soon

[h1][b]Question:[/b][/h1]
Will more driver animations be added? (Shifting, handbraking, .etc)
[h1][b]Answer:[/b][/h1]
Yes, but can't name the exact time yet

[h1][b]Question:[/b][/h1]
Are you considering adding in game voice chat into lobbies?
[h1][b]Answer:[/b][/h1]
Yes, this feature will be added in the nearest future

[h1][b]Question:[/b][/h1]
Are we going to be able to custimize our own liveries?
[h1][b]Answer:[/b][/h1]
Yes. But we are not exactly sure, when this feature will be added

[h1][b]Question:[/b][/h1]
Are there going to be any changes to the physics of the game? 
[h1][b]Answer:[/b][/h1]
Yes, we constantly work on such improvements and will inform you about any changes

[h1][b]Question:[/b][/h1]
Do you consider the possibility to make a location which would have much more space do drift, even more than castle road? Something like a small/medium neighbourhood, a location that would remind of open world
[h1][b]Answer:[/b][/h1]
Similar tracks are planned and are quite possible to be released soon

[h1][b]Question:[/b][/h1]
Do you consider put cars in DLC, not just skins?
[h1][b]Answer:[/b][/h1]
Such DLC are planned, and very soon will be on sale

[h1][b]Question[/b][/h1]
Is there going to be a rework of the engine sounds?
[h1][b]Answer:[/b][/h1]
Of course.

[h1][b]Question:[/b][/h1]
Is there any plan to port the game to Linux ? Or does it use technologies that makes it too hard to handle ?

[b]Add new rating system (Old rating system is disabled)[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/a2727a1dec92c955bb2513f143f24ac946386056.jpg[/img]
Global rating is a seasonal event that lasts 1 month, with a pause between the seasons for 1 week. With the start of the season, all players are qualifying races to determine their rating level. Races in a fast game occur in pairs that is, 2 players participate in the race, the race consists of two races - the total number of drift points for the 2 races is the result of winning the race. Participating in a quick game, players will receive rating points, + N points for the prize place and -N points for the last place in the race. (The formula remains in the current view). 

[b]How it works:[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/5b9f683d1becc94a3a8ce16748a9e4bad03b8afe.jpg[/img]
The season lasts exactly 30 days - While the season lasts players can access the matchmaking mode and they can accumulate points of the rating
After the end of the season, the entire rating of players is frozen and the timeout starts until the beginning of the next season lasting 1 week (information about the timeout is displayed on the matchmaking button)
After the start of the new season, the entire previous rating is updated and the qualification system is launched

[b]Reward for the season:[/b]
At the end of each you will receive a special RP currency as a reward. The higher the league player at the end of the season, the higher his reward in the RP. The rating of the last season is saved in a separate tab in the rating interface. Your maximum rating at the end of the previous season is used as the initial cut-off for qualifying next season.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/30ad6e4493281d63a7f81d49348717765f507b3b.jpg[/img]

[b]Free Camera Mode[/b]
A number of corrections and changes have been made for the free camera mode
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/4e1acd87fc90bfb2684cb6caefc1e0c84c8dc782.jpg[/img]

[b]New game mode Tandem[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/cb52832054f3aab6d4663feb1dcfe16e4c0fab95.jpg[/img]
Mechanics of holding tandems. Arrivals: Tandem passes in 2 arrivals. First race: Leader A leads, player B-slave pursues him. Second race: Player B is in the lead, player A pursues him.

[b]Rules for conducting tandems[/b]
Tandems are held on sites like "Duel" Leading player is traveling on an assignment, the purpose of which is to earn the most amount of drift points with the help of clipping zones / points. For conventional drift, the leading player does not receive drift points. The task of the slave player: to pursue the leading player drift, and also to be at the closest distance to him. The number of drift points earned by the slave depends on the coefficient of coincidence of the angle and distance from the master. Determination of the winner The winner in the tandem is the player who in total for 2 arrivals scored more points than the opponent.

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/a560ed541735cc3e87e11c4b7f9a55a612d0b557.jpg[/img]
[b]Кастомизация[/b]
Добавлены возможности кастомизации для таких авто:
[list]
[*]Panther M5
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/10b43b628291f45e243f6056b6b7252974b7d345.jpg[/img]
[*]EVA MR
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/c8567d892bbeb50d40ecf75efd6d30b2494055b7.jpg[/img]
[*]Asura M1
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/9a186d7d1b3c21b1375a30962ae61984a49f8c34.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[b]Введена новая система рейтинговой игры (Старая рейтинговая система отключена)[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/36374778fd51fd89e10d01da29a02c77ea322d0c.jpg[/img]
Глобальный рейтинг это сезонное событие которое длиться 1 мес. с паузой между сезонами в течении 1 недели. Со стартом сезона все игроки проходят квалификационные заезды для определения их уровня рейтинга. Заезды в быстрой игре происходят попарно то есть участие в заезде принимает 2 игрока, заезд состоит из двух гонок - результатом победы в заезде считается общее количество дрифт очков за 2 заезда. За участие в быстрой игре игроки будут получать рейтинговые очки, +N очков рейтинга за призовое место и -N очков за последнее место в заезде.(формула остается в текущем виде).
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/d754b1ba4e179bf5e612ae26457928f790144c08.jpg[/img]

[b]Как это работает:[/b]
Сезон длится ровно 30 дней - Пока длится сезон игрокам доступен режим быстрой игры и они могут накапливать очки рейтинга
После окончания сезона весь рейтинг игроков замораживается и запускается тайм аут до начала следующего сезона длительностью в 1 неделю (информация про таймаут выводится на плашке быстрой игры)
После старта нового сезона весь предыдущий рейтинг обновляется и запускается система квалификации
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/4b6c88c5b1b65930432c287d620c91364fffee72.jpg[/img]

[b]Награда за сезон:[/b]
В конце каждого вы будете получать в награду специальную валюту RP. Чем выше лига игрока в конце сезона тем выше его награда в RP. Рейтинг прошедшего сезона сохраняется в отдельной вкладке в интерфейсе рейтинга. Ваш максимальный рейтинг в конце предыдущего сезона используется как начальная отсечка для прохождения квалификации в следующем сезоне.

[b]Режим свободной камеры[/b]
Проведен ряд исправлений и изменений для режима свободной камеры
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/d9c1707a74ac660d73d873d7265aaf656c20ce42.jpg[/img]

[b]Новый режим игры Парный дрифт[/b]
Механика проведения тандемов Заезды: Тандем проходит в 2 заезда. Первый заезд: Лидирует игрок А-ведущий, игрок В-ведомый преследует его. Второй заезд: Лидирует игрок В, игрок А преследует его.

[b]Правила проведения Парного дрифта[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/495f49eae9cae14bca9477bf8db602e721333115.jpg[/img]
Тандемы проводятся на участках типа “Дуэль” Ведущий игрок едет по заданию, целью которого является заработать наибольшее количество дрифт очков при помощи клиппинг зон/точек. [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/36374778fd51fd89e10d01da29a02c77ea322d0c.jpg[/img]
Глобальный рейтинг это сезонное событие которое длиться 1 мес. с паузой между сезонами в течении 1 недели. Со стартом сезона все игроки проходят квалификационные заезды для определения их уровня рейтинга. Заезды в быстрой игре происходят попарно то есть участие в заезде принимает 2 игрока, заезд состоит из двух гонок - результатом победы в заезде считается общее количество дрифт очков за 2 заезда. За участие в быстрой игре игроки будут получать рейтинговые очки, +N очков рейтинга за призовое место и -N очков за последнее место в заезде.(формула остается в текущем виде).
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/d754b1ba4e179bf5e612ae26457928f790144c08.jpg[/img]

[b]Как это работает:[/b]
Сезон длится ровно 30 дней - Пока длится сезон игрокам доступен режим быстрой игры и они могут накапливать очки рейтинга
После окончания сезона весь рейтинг игроков замораживается и запускается тайм аут до начала следующего сезона длительностью в 1 неделю (информация про таймаут выводится на плашке быстрой игры)
После старта нового сезона весь предыдущий рейтинг обновляется и запускается система квалификации
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/4b6c88c5b1b65930432c287d620c91364fffee72.jpg[/img]

[b]Награда за сезон:[/b]
В конце каждого вы будете получать в награду специальную валюту RP. Чем выше лига игрока в конце сезона тем выше его награда в RP. Рейтинг прошедшего сезона сохраняется в отдельной вкладке в интерфейсе рейтинга. Ваш максимальный рейтинг в конце предыдущего сезона используется как начальная отсечка для прохождения квалификации в следующем сезоне.

Проведен ряд исправлений и изменений для режима свободной камеры
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/d9c1707a74ac660d73d873d7265aaf656c20ce42.jpg[/img]

[b]Новый режим игры Парный дрифт[/b]
Механика проведения тандемов Заезды: Тандем проходит в 2 заезда. Первый заезд: Лидирует игрок А-ведущий, игрок В-ведомый преследует его. Второй заезд: Лидирует игрок В, игрок А преследует его.

[b]Правила проведения Парного дрифта[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/495f49eae9cae14bca9477bf8db602e721333115.jpg[/img]

Количество дрифт очков, зарабатываемых ведомым, зависит от коэффициента совпадения угла и расстояния от ведущего. notes.title: PTR Update 1.4.3
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/a560ed541735cc3e87e11c4b7f9a55a612d0b557.jpg[/img]
[b]Customization[/b]
[b]Added customization options for such cars:[/b]
[list]
[*]Panther M5
[*]EVA MR
[*]Asura M1
[/list]
[b]Add new rating system (Old rating system is disabled)[/b]
Global rating is a seasonal event that lasts 1 month, with a pause between the seasons for 1 week. With the start of the season, all players are qualifying races to determine their rating level. Races in a fast game occur in pairs that is, 2 players participate in the race, the race consists of two races - the total number of drift points for the 2 races is the result of winning the race. Participating in a quick game, players will receive rating points, + N points for the prize place and -N points for the last place in the race. (The formula remains in the current view). 

[b]How it works:[/b]
The season lasts exactly 30 days - While the season lasts players can access the matchmaking mode and they can accumulate points of the rating
After the end of the season, the entire rating of players is frozen and the timeout starts until the beginning of the next season lasting 1 week (information about the timeout is displayed on the matchmaking button)
After the start of the new season, the entire previous rating is updated and the qualification system is launched

[b]Reward for the season:[/b]
At the end of each you will receive a special RP currency as a reward. The higher the league player at the end of the season, the higher his reward in the RP. The rating of the last season is saved in a separate tab in the rating interface. Your maximum rating at the end of the previous season is used as the initial cut-off for qualifying next season.

[b]Free Camera Mode[/b]
A number of corrections and changes have been made for the free camera mode

notes.title: Questions and Answers #1
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/a560ed541735cc3e87e11c4b7f9a55a612d0b557.jpg[/img]

[h1]What will be new in the next update?[/h1]
[i]So far, our team is actively working at car customization and new system of adjusting the tyre adhesion level. Actually, these features will be our main updates in this release.[/i]

[h1]Will ebisu ever be added in the game ?[/h1]
[i]We are developing ebisu track but because of our busy schedule we can't provide the firm date of release.[/i]

[h1]Will the camaro series has been added in the game?[/h1]
[i]Yes, new camaro cars will be added in the upcoming content patch.[/i]

[h1]Are you going to give some type of Vinyl creator ?[/h1]
[i]Of course, we understand that you want an opportunity to express your personality and  distinguish your car among others.  Regrettably, we can`t say for sure when we start to work at it. But we have plans to implement it as soon as possible.[/i]

[h1]Will there be a guild/team system in-game ?[/h1]
[i]Certainly the guild system with all its modes is one of the most interesting mechanics that gives broad opportunities for gamers. We are planning to evolve the project in that direction, but after release from early access.[/i]

[h1]Will there be mod support ?[/h1]
[i]Definitely, mods support will make the project more varied, but different risks and difficulties are connected with them. We are not ready to say "yes, exactly", at the moment the question about mods support is still opened.[/i]

[h1]Will night mode be added?[/h1]
[i]There are some technical constraints that prevent us from adding the night mode in the near future.[/i]

[h1]Will we add rating bonuses?[/h1]
[i]We are not completely satisfied with the current rating system and it will be redesigned in the next updates taking into all rewards being opened after achieving new rank.[/i]

[b]All questions not included in the first part of our topic 'Questions and Answers' will be published in the second part.[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.2.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29414514/a560ed541735cc3e87e11c4b7f9a55a612d0b557.jpg[/img]

New 'Duel' mode added for multiplayer battles - in this mode, two players must pass through a special section of clipping zones/points. The winner is the player that earns the most drift points. 

[h1]New mechanics:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Clipping zones -  these are special zones on the track marked by a flag and an inscription on the asphalt. Cross these zones in a drift and you’ll get bonus drift points. 
[*] Clipping point - this is a key point on the track in which your vehicle must move with a rear drift, keeping as close as possible to the clipping point with the front or rear bumper and following the trajectory shown. The closer you get to the clipping point, the more drift points you’ll get. 
[*] New customization element - Wheel rim changing, allowing you to change the wheel rim model on your car. 
[*] New server - Increased the player limit in a single room from 8 to 16 players
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with mousewheel navigation
[*]Fixed number of bonus drift points earned for event
[*] Analyzed and lowered amount of experience required to level up
[/list]

[h1]Interface:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Rewrote UI of multiplayer and singleplayer races
    [*]Statistics window was added (Tab button by default)
    [*]We have added variety of events you receive extra points for
[/list]

[h1]New achievements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Earn 150000 DP in the Great entry event
[*] Earn 150000 DP in the Transition event
[*] Earn 200000 DP in the Awesome angle event
[*] Earn 500000 DP in the Unstoppable event
[*] Earn 350000 DP in the Smooth drift event
[*] Earn 500000 DP in the Backward event
[*] Earn 650000 DP in the Clipping Zone event
[*] Earn 650000 DP in the Clipping Point event
[/list]
